description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Permission in terms of Sec. 22(4) of the Exchange Control Act given to exporters of goods with effect from 01.08.2016
reasoning: This gazette notice contains regulatory requirements for exporters regarding foreign exchange controls, specifically outlining procedures for repatriation of export proceeds and submission of documentary evidence. It is issued under the Exchange Control Act by the Controller of Exchange at the Central Bank, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
